project.summary: Zero Maps is an experimental Mars exploration and EVA planning interface focused on Jezero Crater. It combines illustrative terrain, traverse planning, local-time and Earth–Mars light-time displays, and account-backed workspace sync.

company.name: Celesta
company.tagline: A team building tools for exploring other worlds.
company.about: Celesta is the team behind Zero Maps. The project is a prototype for exploring Martian terrain and organizing mission-planning ideas. Add the team’s own approved description and links before publishing.

credits.label: NASA Photojournal · Jezero Crater elevation graph (PIA26476)

disclosures: The terrain, mineral hypotheses, route costs, and EVA resource margins shown in the current planner are illustrative simulations, not validated operational data or safety guidance.
Earth–Mars distance and one-way light time are computed from approximate Keplerian orbital elements. They are not a communications link prediction.
The rover profile is an approximate digitization of the cited NASA graphic. Confirm data sources and team disclosures before submission.
